objects.name: Analytic 2077
objects.description: Detect successful SaaS authentication through an application-specific or legacy credential mechanism from a source/client not previously associated with that account, correlated with new session establishment or subsequent access inconsistent with ApprovedASPUsage.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: saas:audit
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Successful application-specific/legacy credential authentication where exposed

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: saas:session
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: New authenticated session associated with changed source/client context

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Approved user/application/use-case relationships for ASP authentication—for example, which user or service is expected to use an ASP with which application. Derive from documented integration workflows and service ownership. Broadening permitted relationships reduces FP but increases FN for abused legitimate credentials; narrowing them increases detection sensitivity and FP.
